task.title: To view or edit a segment condition

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
From the Contracts pane, click the Home icon () and select Templates.
In the Templates pane, go to Work tab, click the Dropdown icon ()and select Segments.

Select the Segment from the segments list and click the Settings icon () next to the segment name. This opens the Segment Settingspage. where the Segment Typeis set to Conditional for that segment. To edit the conditional, click the Edit button () next to Condition. At the time of contract generation, if your conditional value evaluates to true, the associated segment is shown in the contract document.
